shots.note: Cellarius's Ptolemaic cosmos, the Earth at the centre (1660): 'conventional conceptions… taken for objective facts that everyone knows and no one questions'
Bruegel, The Blind Leading the Blind (1568): 'narrow-minded bigotry and blind prejudice' (ends on the join)
Daumier, Le Ventre législatif (1834), smug legislators on their benches: 'That arrogance, that prejudice, that bias, and bigotry' (on the join after 'bigoted on the right… left… center')
a padlocked door: 'just having a closed mind… you're not open' (covers the join)
Thomas Cole, The Course of Empire: Destruction (1836): 'the person, the nation, the world starts to degenerate'
the Flammarion engraving, a traveller putting his head through the sky to see beyond it: 'what we need is something from the outside, some creativity from the outside' (covers the join)
Boeing's own 737 MAX in house colours: 'a corporation… knows that they're the best, knows that their designs are the best designs' (covers the join)
grounded 737 MAX jets parked near Boeing Field, 2019: 'like Boeing, that's not good' (ends on the join)
Apple Park from the air: 'so sure that they knew everything, with regard to design, with regard to manufacture' (ends on the join)
a queue camped outside an Apple Store, 2010: 'everyone knows they're good, everyone knows they're beautiful, and no one questions it' (ends on the join)
a 1940s Camel advertisement: 'More doctors smoke Camels than any other cigarette': 'smoking was thought to be good for you'
a No Smoking sign, set high on a dark field so the captions stay clear of its lettering: 'these two attitudes have changed'
a family gathered round the television, 1958: 'conditioned and determined by your environment… what you see on TV' (on the join, covers the next)
a phone full of social-media apps: 'what you see on Instagram… TikTok and X'

Earthrise, Apollo 8 (1968), the whole Earth seen from outside it: 'anybody who can get out of that and look more holistically can do better, because they can see more clearly' (covers the join, to the end)
